summary.business_type: Local Service / B2B dealer - multi-location heavy equipment distributor (authorised Tata Hitachi distributor, Nepal). Hybrid brick-and-mortar plus service-area.
summary.stack: Vite + React 19 SPA, react-router-dom v7, client-side rendering only. Vercel behind Cloudflare; API on Render.
top_findings: Every page serves an identical 830-byte empty HTML shell - pure client-side rendering with no pre-rendering.
All 10 public routes share one hardcoded title 'Tata Hitachi Nepal'; no meta descriptions, canonicals, or Open Graph tags exist anywhere.
Unknown URLs return HTTP 200 with a blank rendered page - soft 404s across the entire site.
Homepage transfers 46.9 MB of images, including a single 29.3 MB JPEG displayed at 935x816, plus a 22 MB autoplaying hero video.

robots.txt (Cloudflare-managed) blocks GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider and meta-externalagent - excluding the site from AI answers and Google AI Overviews grounding.
quick_wins: Add per-route title, meta description and canonical via react-helmet-async (~2h) - largest single ranking lever available.
Ship a static /public/sitemap.xml for the 10 public routes and add a Sitemap: directive to robots.txt.
Re-export the 29.3 MB and 13.0 MB hero JPEGs to ~200 KB WebP at 1920px - removes ~42 MB from the homepage with no visible quality loss.
Add LocalBusiness + Organization JSON-LD from the already-structured data in frontend/src/data/locations.js.
Add an <h1> to the homepage hero and alt text to the 6 unlabelled homepage images.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS enforced with strict-transport-security: max-age=63072000.
Apex to www canonicalised with a 308 redirect; http:// also 308s.
Fast server response - TTFB 67 ms, Vercel edge cache HIT.
Clean, readable URL structure with no query-string or ID noise.
html lang="en" set correctly.
Admin routes are auth-gated and render nothing to crawlers.

findings.title: Client-side rendering only - no HTML content for crawlers
findings.description:
Raw GET / returns 830 bytes: head plus
. The rendered DOM contains 6,663 characters of homepage text. vercel.json rewrites /((?!api/).*) to /index.html so this applies to all 10 routes. Bing and every AI crawler receive an empty document.
findings.recommendation: Add build-time pre-rendering via vite-react-ssg or vite-plugin-prerender, listing the 10 public routes. The app still hydrates as an SPA afterwards. Verify with curl that body copy is present without JS.

findings.title: Soft 404s - unknown URLs return HTTP 200
findings.description: https://www.dugarearthmovers.com.np/this-page-does-not-exist-12345 returns 200 and renders a blank page (1 word of text). App.jsx has no catch-all route.
findings.recommendation: Add <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} /> inside the Layout route with robots noindex, and return a real 404 status once pre-rendering is in place.

findings.title: No XML sitemap
findings.description: /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml both return the SPA shell as text/html with status 200.
findings.recommendation: Generate frontend/public/sitemap.xml with the 10 public routes; build blog URLs at deploy time from GET /api/posts.

findings.title: robots.txt is Cloudflare-managed, blocks AI crawlers and has no Sitemap directive
findings.description: Allow: / for User-agent: * with Content-Signal: search=yes is correct for Googlebot and Bingbot. But GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, meta-externalagent and CloudflareBrowserRenderingCrawler are all disallowed. No Sitemap: line.
findings.recommendation: Add a Sitemap: directive. Reconsider the Google-Extended block via the Cloudflare AI Crawler Control dashboard - hand-editing the file will be overwritten by the managed rule.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: content-security-policy, x-frame-options, x-content-type-options, referrer-policy and permissions-policy are all absent. The site accepts form submissions.
findings.recommendation: Add a headers block to vercel.json with nosniff, referrer-policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, and x-frame-options: SAMEORIGIN.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt returns the SPA shell. Optional and ignored by Google Search, but a low-cost signal for AI assistants.
findings.recommendation: Add frontend/public/llms.txt once the AI crawler policy is settled.

findings.title: Build output is 149.58 MB
findings.description: Symptom of the unoptimised asset pipeline; slows every build and deploy.
findings.recommendation: Adopt vite-imagetools so assets are compressed and resized at build time.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Copy is distinctive and human-written with no AI-generic filler.
Strong raw E-E-A-T material: five-generation family business, named authorised distributor relationship, named branch contacts across 10 cities.
Real machine specifications sourced from 10 downloadable OEM brochures.
On-site operator reviews from real customers.
Privacy (656 words) and Terms (774 words) are substantive and site-specific, not boilerplate.
Every page except the homepage has a unique, well-written h1.

findings.title: Homepage has no h1
findings.description: The heading tree starts at H2 'FIVE SPECIALTIES. One yard.' HeroSlideshow.jsx renders only a video, images and nav arrows - no text overlay at all. The most important page has no primary heading and no above-the-fold copy naming the business, brand or country.
findings.recommendation:
Add a hero overlay with

Tata Hitachi Excavators & Backhoe Loaders in Nepal

plus a one-line subhead.

findings.title: Thin content across several pages
findings.description: Rendered word counts: /blog 104, /leadership 159, /about 443, /contact 471, /compare 490, /privacy 656, /terms 774, /products 814. /products covers 10 machines in 814 words - roughly 80 words per machine.
findings.recommendation: Expand each page; individual product pages are the highest-value fix (see below).

findings.title: No individual product URLs
findings.description: All 10 machines live on one /products page with #excavators-style anchors. Commercial-intent searches such as 'ZAXIS 220LC price Nepal' have no page to land on.
findings.recommendation: Create /products/:slug for all 10 machines from the structured data already in frontend/src/data/products.js, 400-600 words each.

findings.title: Blog looks empty to a crawler
findings.description: /blog measured at 104 words. The API in fact serves five published posts - blog.js has no bundled fallback, so the page renders its skeleton and only fills in once GET /api/posts returns. The backend sleeps on Render's free tier and a cold request can take ~30s, so anything sampling the page before then sees an empty blog. That is what a crawler gets.
findings.recommendation: The content is fine; delivery is the problem. Pre-render the blog index, or keep the backend warm. Then keep publishing - 8-12 posts on machine selection, monsoon service intervals and genuine vs aftermarket parts.

findings.title: No author attribution or dates on content
findings.description: BlogPost.jsx renders posts with no Person byline or credential. In a technical B2B vertical, a named reviewer with stated experience carries more E-E-A-T weight than the article itself.
findings.recommendation: Add author bios with credentials and datePublished, backed by BlogPosting schema.

findings.title: No service-area or location landing pages
findings.description: Ten branches with named contacts exist in locations.js but appear only as a list and map on /contact. Queries like 'excavator service Pokhara' have nowhere to rank.
findings.recommendation: Create /locations/:city pages for the 10 service branches with genuinely local content.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Nine of ten pages have unique, descriptive, well-written h1 elements.
Heading hierarchy within pages is logical (h1 to h2 to h3).
Internal linking between the main sections is complete via the navbar and footer.
URL slugs are clean and keyword-relevant.

findings.title: One title tag for the entire site
findings.description: All 10 public routes return <title>Tata Hitachi Nepal</title>, hardcoded in frontend/index.html. 19 characters, well under the ~60-character budget, with no service, product or location terms.
findings.recommendation: Set unique per-route titles. Draft copy is in FULL-AUDIT-REPORT.md under On-Page SEO.

findings.title: No meta descriptions anywhere
findings.description: The only meta tags in the document are charset and viewport. With no homepage h1 and no intro copy, Google has very little to scrape for a snippet.
findings.recommendation: Add a unique 150-155 character meta description per route.

findings.title: No canonical tags
findings.description: Zero <link rel="canonical"> on any page. The apex 308 covers the main duplication risk, but anchor URLs and future UTM traffic have no canonical anchor.
findings.recommendation: Add a self-referencing canonical to every route.

findings.title: No Open Graph or Twitter Card tags
findings.description: Every share on WhatsApp, Facebook, LinkedIn or Viber renders as a bare link with no image and no description. In Nepal's B2B market where WhatsApp sharing drives referral traffic, this is a direct commercial loss.
findings.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type and twitter:card=summary_large_image. Produce one 1200x630 default OG image.

findings.title: No head-management library installed
findings.description: frontend/package.json contains no react-helmet-async, @unhead/react or equivalent. There is currently no mechanism to set per-page meta.
findings.recommendation: Install react-helmet-async, or write a small useDocumentHead hook - the site is small enough not to need the dependency.

findings.title: Zero structured data on the entire site
findings.description: document.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]').length === 0 on every one of the 10 routes.
findings.recommendation: Start with Organization/AutoDealer sitewide and LocalBusiness for the 10 branches.

findings.title: Missing LocalBusiness schema for 10 branches
findings.description: frontend/src/data/locations.js already holds city, lat/lng, contact name, phone and Google Maps URL for each branch. This is the highest-ROI schema on the site and is a data transform rather than new research.
findings.recommendation: Emit 10 LocalBusiness blocks with name, address, geo, telephone, openingHours and parentOrganization. Requires collecting street addresses and opening hours, which are not currently in the codebase.

findings.title: Missing Product schema for 10 machines
findings.description: No Product markup exists. Currently blocked by the absence of individual product URLs.
findings.recommendation: After creating /products/:slug, add Product schema with name, brand: Tata Hitachi, image, description and spec additionalProperty entries.

findings.title: Missing FAQPage schema
findings.description: Faqs.jsx already renders a Q&A section ('LET'S CLEAR IT UP.') on the homepage with no markup on it.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage JSON-LD mirroring the rendered questions and answers.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList and BlogPosting schema
findings.description: No breadcrumb markup anywhere; /blog/:slug in particular would benefit. Blog posts carry no BlogPosting headline, datePublished, author or image.
findings.recommendation: Add both once the blog has published content.

findings.title: Missing Review markup on existing reviews
findings.description: Reviews.jsx renders real operator reviews with no schema. Note Google restricts self-serving review snippets on LocalBusiness.
findings.recommendation: Apply Review/AggregateRating to Product entities where the reviews are genuinely machine-specific.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: TTFB 67 ms - excellent, Vercel edge cache HIT.
FCP 192 ms.
CLS 0.000 - no layout shift observed.
Only 18 requests; JS and CSS transfer is negligible next to imagery.

findings.title: 46.9 MB of images on the homepage
findings.description: Measured transfer breakdown is effectively 100% img. Worst offenders: ZX220LC Ultra 6.jpg at 29.3 MB (5760x3840 natural, 935x816 displayed, ~99% waste), ZAXIS 140H Ultra.JPG at 13.0 MB (6000x4000), IMG_5291.JPG at 2.3 MB and IMG_5286.JPG at 1.5 MB (both 4032x2268 displayed at 435x327). On a 10 Mbps Nepali 4G connection this is roughly 38 seconds of download.
findings.recommendation: Re-export all hero and card imagery to WebP, max 1920px wide, quality 80. Target 47 MB down to under 1.5 MB. Adopt vite-imagetools for automatic build-time processing.

findings.title: All 7 hero slides load eagerly on first paint
findings.description: HeroSlideshow.jsx mounts every slide as a div with opacity-0, so the browser fetches all six images plus the 22 MB video immediately - even though only slide 0 is visible and there is no auto-advance.
findings.recommendation: Render only the active slide and the next one; lazy-load slides 2-6.

findings.title: Lab LCP of 216 ms is misleading
findings.description: The LCP element resolved against an early-painting overlay while 47 MB of imagery was still streaming. Measured on desktop from Kathmandu on a warm cache. No CrUX field data available - the site is likely below the reporting threshold.
findings.recommendation: Re-measure after image optimisation, and connect Search Console to get real field data.

findings.title: 22 MB hero video with preload=auto and autoplay
findings.description: hero.mp4 is 22.1 MB, set to autoPlay with preload="auto" and no poster attribute.
findings.recommendation: Add a poster image, switch to preload="metadata", and re-encode to 1080p H.264 targeting 2-3 MB for a 15-second loop.

findings.title: No responsive images and no explicit dimensions
findings.description: No srcset, sizes or <picture> anywhere - mobile downloads the same 29 MB file as desktop. No width/height attributes on any img; CLS is 0 only because the layout is fully CSS-constrained, which is fragile.
findings.recommendation: Add srcset at 1920/1280/640 widths and explicit width/height on every img.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Content-Signal: search=yes permits classic search indexing.
Underlying content is factual, specific and would be highly citable if it were reachable and restructured.

findings.title: AI crawlers blocked at robots.txt
findings.description: Cloudflare's managed block disallows GPTBot (ChatGPT), ClaudeBot (Claude), CCBot (Common Crawl, which feeds many models and Perplexity's index), Google-Extended (Gemini and Google AI Overviews grounding), Applebot-Extended, Bytespider and meta-externalagent. Combined with Content-Signal: ai-train=no, use=reference. When a contractor asks an AI assistant who sells Tata Hitachi excavators in Nepal, this site cannot be cited.
findings.recommendation: Business decision. Reconsider Google-Extended first - it governs AI Overviews grounding that appears directly above the organic results a buyer already sees, and unblocking it does not affect classic Search ranking. Content-Signal: ai-train=no already reserves training rights separately. Change via the Cloudflare AI Crawler Control dashboard, not by editing the file.

findings.title: Content invisible to AI crawlers even if unblocked
findings.description: Every AI crawler listed fetches raw HTML and does not execute JavaScript. Even with robots.txt opened up, they would receive the 830-byte empty shell.
findings.recommendation: Pre-rendering is a hard prerequisite for any GEO work here.

findings.title: No structured data for entity resolution
findings.description: The strongest machine-readable signal for AI systems to resolve the business as an entity is entirely absent.
findings.recommendation: Ship Organization and LocalBusiness JSON-LD (see Schema category).

findings.title: Low passage-level citability
findings.description: Copy is stylish but rhetorical - 'FIVE SPECIALTIES. One yard.' AI systems cite self-contained factual passages, not headlines.
findings.recommendation: Add citable statements such as 'Dugar Earthmovers is the authorised Tata Hitachi distributor for Nepal, operating 10 service and parts branches from Biratnagar to Dhangadi.'

findings.title: No llms.txt and weak brand-mention footprint
findings.description: /llms.txt returns the SPA shell. The site's only external outbound authority link is to mvdugar.com.
findings.recommendation: Add llms.txt once crawler policy is settled; pursue industry directory and trade-body mentions.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Products, Leadership, Compare, Contact and Blog have complete alt coverage.
Existing alt text is descriptive rather than keyword-stuffed.

findings.title: 6 of 15 homepage images have empty alt
findings.description: All six are hero slides with alt="" hardcoded in HeroSlideshow.jsx. Decorative-empty-alt is defensible for a pure background, but these are the product photos that define the page. The About page has 4 of 35 images with empty alt.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real machine descriptions naming the model.

findings.title: Images grossly oversized for display
findings.description: Roughly 99% byte waste on the largest assets - see the Performance category for the full table.
findings.recommendation: Resize and convert to WebP at build time.

findings.title: Mixed and unoptimised formats
findings.description: A mix of .JPG, .jpeg, .png and one .webp. The 1.1 MB zaxis 370.png is a photograph stored as PNG.
findings.recommendation: Standardise on WebP with JPEG fallback.

findings.title: Non-descriptive filenames with spaces
findings.description: IMG_5291.JPG, IMG_5286.JPG and 'WhatsApp Image 2026-06-23 at 9.56.05 AM.jpeg' hurt image search; spaces force URL-encoding on every request.
findings.recommendation: Rename to lowercase hyphenated descriptive filenames, e.g. tata-hitachi-parts-store-nepal.webp.

findings.title: No image sitemap
findings.description: No image entries in any sitemap - and no sitemap exists at all.
findings.recommendation: Include image:image entries when generating sitemap.xml.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: 10 service and parts branches with city, coordinates, named contact and direct phone, admin-managed via locations.js.
7 additional named sales contacts across Biratnagar, Birgunj, Pokhara, Nepalgunj and Kathmandu.
Interactive MapLibre map on /contact with Google Maps deep links per branch.
tel: links used throughout - strong mobile conversion mechanics.

findings.title: NAP is incomplete and inconsistent
findings.description: The footer gives only 'Kathmandu, Nepal' - no street address, no postal code, no opening hours anywhere on the site. locations.js has coordinates but no streetAddress field.
findings.recommendation: Collect and publish full street addresses and opening hours per branch; keep them identical across the site, GBP and directories.

findings.title: No per-location pages
findings.description: Ten branches, zero URLs to rank for '[service] [city]' queries.
findings.recommendation: Create /locations/:city pages with 300+ words of genuinely local content each.

findings.title: Generic Gmail address as primary contact
findings.description: sales.tatahitachinp@gmail.com is used sitewide on a business that owns its own domain - a weak trust signal for users and local ranking alike.
findings.recommendation: Move to sales@dugarearthmovers.com.np.

findings.title: Google Business Profile status not verifiable from the site
findings.description: No GBP links and no review widgets pulling from Google. Local pack visibility for this business will come more from GBP than from the website.
findings.recommendation: Confirm all 10 branches have claimed, correctly-categorised GBP listings with matching NAP, photos and an active review-request habit.

categories.name: Search Experience (SXO)
what_works: Conversion mechanics are stronger than acquisition mechanics - tel: links throughout, named humans per branch, working enquiry form.
Navigation is clear and every main section is reachable in one click.

findings.title: Page-type mismatch on /products
findings.description: Commercial queries for a specific machine model expect a product detail page. A single category listing with anchors cannot satisfy that intent.
findings.recommendation: Individual product URLs - the highest-value content investment on the site.

findings.title: No above-the-fold value proposition
findings.description: The hero is pure imagery with no text. A visitor arriving from search sees a video with no statement of who this is or what they sell until they scroll.
findings.recommendation: Add hero headline and subhead copy naming the brand, the distributor relationship and the coverage.

findings.title: Persona gap - the parts buyer
findings.description: 'Genuine Parts' is one homepage tile with no destination page, despite being a high-frequency, high-intent, repeat-purchase query cluster.
findings.recommendation: Build a dedicated genuine parts landing page.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Per-page title, meta description, canonical and Open Graph tags via react-helmet-async (~2h) - highest ROI on the site.
Pre-render the SPA to static HTML with vite-react-ssg for the 10 public routes (~4-6h) - unblocks everything else.
Fix the 47 MB homepage: re-export the 29.3 MB and 13.0 MB JPEGs to WebP, lazy-load hero slides 2-6, add a video poster and preload=metadata (~3h).
Add a catch-all 404 route with robots noindex (~30m).
Publish /public/sitemap.xml and add a Sitemap: directive to robots.txt (~1h).
Add a homepage h1 and alt text for the 6 unlabelled hero images (~1h).
Decide the AI crawler policy in Cloudflare AI Crawler Control, starting with Google-Extended (~15m decision).

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Individual product pages at /products/:slug for all 10 machines, 400-600 words each (~1-2d) - biggest content lever.
LocalBusiness JSON-LD for the 10 branches plus sitewide Organization/AutoDealer (~3h).
Product schema on the new product pages (~2h).
FAQPage schema on the existing homepage FAQ section (~1h).
Per-location pages at /locations/:city for the 10 service branches (~1-2d).
Security headers in vercel.json - nosniff, referrer-policy, x-frame-options (~30m).
Lazy-load below-the-fold images, add srcset and explicit width/height, rename non-descriptive files (~2h).

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Launch the blog with 8-12 posts on machine selection, monsoon service intervals and genuine vs aftermarket parts.
Build a dedicated genuine parts landing page (~4h).
Add E-E-A-T signals: named author bios with credentials, certifications, distributor agreements (~4h).
Move from sales.tatahitachinp@gmail.com to sales@dugarearthmovers.com.np (~30m).
Claim and optimise Google Business Profile for all 10 branches (~1d).
Publish case studies with named contractors and machine models.

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools and submit the sitemap - nothing is measurable until GSC is connected.
Add GA4 with conversion events on tel: clicks and enquiry-form submissions.
Monthly check of GSC Coverage for soft-404 regressions and CrUX Core Web Vitals field data.
Re-run this audit quarterly and baseline SEO-critical elements so deploys can be diffed for regressions.
Track rankings for: tata hitachi nepal, excavator dealer nepal, [model] price nepal, excavator service [city].

limitations: Indexation status not verified - WebSearch was unavailable in this session and no Google Search Console credentials are configured.
No CrUX field data available; all Core Web Vitals figures are lab measurements from a single warm-cache desktop session in Kathmandu.
Screenshots were not captured to disk.
The /blog/:slug route was not audited with live content - the blog is API-driven and currently renders no posts.
